## AI lead finder (Google Maps → scored leads → Sheets + CSV)
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/leads

1. Visitor enters a business type, a place and what they sell (or picks a sample).
2. **SerpAPI (Google Maps engine)** returns up to 20 listings; a place is cached for 7 days so repeats cost no searches. Caps: 10 live searches a day, 200 a month (free plan = 250).
3. n8n **visits up to 12 websites in parallel** (6 s timeout) and finds emails, booking tools, chat widgets, WhatsApp links, social profiles, site platform.
4. **Gemini** scores every business 0–100 for the offer (hot / warm / cold), explains why, picks the best channel and writes an opening line.
5. Sorted list → **Google Sheets** (Leads tab) + CSV download + private owner view.

Successful executions are not saved (homepage HTML never sits in the log). Nothing is sent to the businesses.
Built by Aqib ur Rehman. Harborline is fictional; the businesses are real public listings.
